# Versions of: Launching the sovereign website appliance

3 published versions of [Launching the sovereign website appliance: the plan for a Kickstarter campaign that sells a sovereign website on a configured Android tablet or a Raspberry Pi, five tiers from a £50 supporter to £1,000, the two Pro tiers running local AI models that can build a website on the device itself, the hardware we would buy in the UK today, a European tablet, the UK as the base goal with countries and iOS as stretch goals, and why we launch alone](../launching-the-sovereign-website-appliance.md). The current one is **v1.1.0**.

v1.0.0 is the article as first published. A change to its text (title, abstract or body) is the next minor version, v1.1.0; a change only to its other details (a LinkedIn link, the release it belongs to) is the next patch, v1.0.1. The list is read from the site's git history at every build, so it cannot be edited by hand and cannot leave a version out. Views extracted from an article, such as the Five readers, are not part of its text and do not change its version.
